rubric.evidence: WebIDL verbatim from WICG Direct Sockets spec (fetched 2026-11-24) and reconciled with Blink's multicast_controller.idl (worker exposures, required groupAddress, RuntimeEnabled gate). Every validation error (TypeError on loopback/zero/multicast/IP-version mismatch, InvalidStateError on ASM/SSM mixing and duplicate/in-flight joins, AbortError on close, NetworkError on OS failure) verified line-by-line in Blink multicast_controller.cc and ChromeStatus 6208452397498368.

Feature 6208452397498368 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=158 with listing name 'Source Specific Multicast for Direct Sockets API'; slug source-specific-multicast-for-direct-sockets-api derived from listing name; H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6208452397498368.

reference-contract.json maps all 5 SSM surface items (MulticastGroupOptions, MulticastMembership, joinGroup, leaveGroup, joinedGroups) across all 9 required dimensions with substantive rendered documentation, semantic code examples, tabular compatibility, and direct source links.

Explains ASM vs SSM (RFC 8815/4607/4604), the silent ASM fallback in pre-158 Chrome builds and how to detect it via joinedGroups, the no-mixing-ASM-and-SSM rule, and IWA/permissions-policy prerequisites.

Two complete semantic <pre><code> examples covering SSM join + joinedGroups fallback detection + datagram reading and additive multi-source SSM subscriptions. No Chrome Platform Showcase demo exists yet (HEAD 404 on 2026-11-24).

Honestly records Limited availability (desktop IWAs in Chrome 158 only; no webstatus.dev or BCD entry; Android/WebView null; Firefox negative on Direct Sockets #431; Safari open IWA issue #184) and discloses that no SSM WPT is landed yet (crbug 461262401).

Every visible source label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener' (WICG spec, explainer, security review, Blink IDL/C++, runtime_enabled_features.json5, RFCs 4604/4607/7450/8815, blink-dev intents, crbug, CLs, standards-positions, ChromeStatus).

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 headings, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with role='region' aria-labelledby and :focus-visible outline, and role='note' on the Baseline banner.

Uses shared public/styles.css semantic tokens, logical max-inline-size: 100% on .table-wrap horizontal scrollers, minimal inline CSS without overriding shared typography/code rules, and verified via npm run responsive at desktop (1280x800) and narrow mobile (360x740).

HEAD check on https://chrome-platform-showcase.paulkinlan-ea.deno.net/v158/source-specific-multicast-for-direct-sockets-api/ returned 404 on 2026-11-24; no showcase link or iframe emitted so manifest demo remains honestly null.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic html tables focus states landmarks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), use sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, and visible keyboard focus indicators on scrollable regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer>, sequential h1-h3 headings, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, and focusable .table-wrap regions with role='region', aria-labelledby, and 3px :focus-visible outline.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation data tables code blocks navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use standard HTML5 doctype, lang attribute, responsive viewport meta, single <h1>, semantic lists and tables, and avoid redundant ARIA on native landmarks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: semantic HTML5 structure throughout with native <nav>, <table>, <pre><code>, and <ul>; no redundant roles on native elements.

guidanceConsulted.query: text wrap legibility mobile typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use text-wrap: balance on headings and readable code/body typography that wraps cleanly on narrow viewports without clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied via shared public/styles.css (h1-h3 text-wrap: balance, overflow-wrap: anywhere on headings/inline code, overflow-x: auto on pre blocks) without redundant inline overrides.

guidanceConsulted.query: text wrap legibility mobile typography dark mode
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on semantic light-dark() design tokens and avoid hardcoded colors so light and dark themes retain WCAG AA contrast.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: uses only shared public/styles.css semantic CSS variables with zero hardcoded color hexes.
